name: Invisible Hunter
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level elven archer 1, inquisitor 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You and all your gear become invisible to one creature chosen at the time of casting. All other creatures can see you normally. This spell otherwise acts as invisibility.
